frozen_contracts: Inputs are the exact allowlisted BuiltinCharacterConfig IDs and validated lowercase #rrggbb hair/primary/secondary colors; output is canonical 128x224 RGBA PNG bytes with four 32x32 frames for idle, walk, listen, think, talk, success, offline in that order.

Layer order is body/skin, outfit, hair, accessory. Built-in source geometry is module-owned deterministic pixel masks or primitives with stable IDs; all 28 frames contain visible pixels and sheet transparency remains present.
Generated bytes must be accepted later by the Main-owned canonical custom-sprite validator unchanged; the worker must not implement, import, or modify that validator.
No dependency, asset binary, registry contract outside sprite_composer.py, public API, configuration model, bundle/card serializer, or documentation change is permitted.
